info.title: OCPP CPMS API
info.description: The API your CPMS backend must implement. Every endpoint is tagged with the milestone in `docs/` that introduces it. Implement `GET /api/v1/health` first — the frontend probes it to decide whether to use your backend or its own mocks.

get.description:
The frontend probes this on boot in learn mode. Answer it and the UI switches from mock data to yours. Build this one first.

**Milestone 0** in the build guide.
